note: Bytes copied verbatim from aukora-membrane minimal/replicas/ at commit d8b17fac and never edited. This is the Rust third-runtime replica that upstream-phase0.json previously listed as deliberately not vendored; vendoring it now retires that exclusion for the sources but not for the build output. Retaining this tree at all is the pin: scripts/phase0-check-pins.py recomputes every sha256 and byte length below and refuses on any drift, extra sibling or missing file. rust-verifier/target/ (cargo build output, 198 files upstream) is deliberately NOT vendored; it is regenerated by the build documented in SELFTEST.md and is covered by rust-verifier/.gitignore. Building this tree in place creates target/ and the Cargo registry cache; neither is a source byte and neither is pinned here.

genesisAuthored.why: This manifest. A file cannot carry its own digest. Genesis-authored, not upstream bytes, so pinning it as upstream would be a false provenance claim; whichever checker consumes it should require it by name instead.
